parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no populated `members` array and all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_ancestor`, `shared_field_count`) are null. Without concrete field lists or overlap metrics for `Announcement.CodingKeys` and `Playcut.CodingKeys`, there is no grounded evidence that the two nested `CodingKeys` enums share meaningful structure beyond the coincidence of both being `CodingKeys` enumerations — a pattern that is idiomatic and expected for any two `Codable` types in the same package. Recommending a refactor without member-level evidence would require hallucination.
